headline: Reference-matched assemblies enable cistrome and methylation-variant analysis in crops
label: Plant Pangenome Reference Genomes
summary: Short-read composite and linear pan-references now support TF footprinting and epigenetic-genetic profiling across diverse crop accessions.
synthesis: The common thread across these preprints is that variant-aware analysis in plant genomes depends on the reference used to represent each sample. A composited barley genome, built from short-read drafts via SNP-replacement and PHG composite strategies, was tested for MOA-seq transcription factor footprint analysis across cultivars. UMR-seq captures unmethylated regions while sequencing genetic variants in a single assay, enabling low-cost population-scale epigenetic and genetic analysis across diverse plant species. WheatPanRef offers a unified linear pan-reference for wheat, an 18.87-Gb assembly reconciled from Chinese Spring assemblies with non-CS sequences from 37 accessions. The new element is pairing pan-reference representation with regulatory and epigenetic readouts, extending reference-dependent analysis beyond conventional variant calling.
